data.description:
## Testing Mode
UPDATE

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- DD1: mode-detect.sh one-line read-config.sh dso.workflow lookup; legacy detection removed
- DD5: TDD: tests RED before changes; unit tests passing (this is the RED phase for DD1)

## What to Change
Modify `tests/hooks/test-mode-detect.sh` to assert the NEW behavior:
- Given a config with ONLY `dso.workflow=ci-pr`, when mode-detect.sh is called, output is `ci-pr`
- Given a config with ONLY `dso.workflow=local`, output is `local`
- Given an empty/missing config, output is `local` (graceful degradation)
- Remove the git-stub helper (no longer needed — remote detection is eliminated)
- Replace `DSO_CONFIG_PATH` fixture injection with `WORKFLOW_CONFIG_FILE` (matching read-config.sh's test isolation mechanism)
- The old tests (test_mode_detect_local_empty_remote, test_mode_detect_non_ci_enforcement, test_mode_detect_non_pr_merge) must be replaced by tests that use `dso.workflow` directly
- The modified test MUST FAIL before Task 2 is implemented (mode-detect.sh still reads legacy keys)

## Test Approach (Given / When / Then)
- **Given**: a fixture config containing only `dso.workflow=ci-pr` (no legacy keys), WORKFLOW_CONFIG_FILE set to fixture path
- **When**: `bash mode-detect.sh` is executed
- **Then**: stdout is exactly `ci-pr` and exit code is 0

- **Given**: a fixture config containing only `dso.workflow=local`
- **When**: `bash mode-detect.sh`
- **Then**: stdout is `local`

- **Given**: no config file (WORKFLOW_CONFIG_FILE points to absent path or empty)
- **When**: `bash mode-detect.sh`
- **Then**: stdout is `local` (graceful fallback, exit 0)

## .test-index RED Marker Requirement
After updating the test, update `.test-index` entry for `plugins/dso/scripts/mode-detect.sh`:
Add RED markers for the new test function names (e.g., `[test_mode_detect_reads_dso_workflow_ci_pr]`).

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0) — note: THIS task's test should FAIL pre-implementation; the suite overall must pass (use RED marker to allow failure)
  Verify: bash tests/hooks/test-mode-detect.sh 2>&1 | tail -1 | grep -qE 'FAILED: 0\b' || grep -q '\[.*\]' .test-index
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py 2>/dev/null || true
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff format --check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py 2>/dev/null || true
- [ ] Test file `tests/hooks/test-mode-detect.sh` updated with new test functions asserting dso.workflow behavior
  Verify: grep -q 'dso.workflow\|dso_workflow' tests/hooks/test-mode-detect.sh
- [ ] Old tests using git-stub + enforcement.strategy/merge.strategy fixture removed
  Verify: ! grep -q 'make_git_stub\|enforcement\.strategy\|merge\.strategy' tests/hooks/test-mode-detect.sh
- [ ] `.test-index` updated with RED marker for new test function name
  Verify: grep '\[test_mode_detect_reads_dso_workflow' .test-index
- [ ] New test FAILS when run against current (unmodified) mode-detect.sh
  Verify: manual verification — run `bash tests/hooks/test-mode-detect.sh` before Task 2 and confirm non-zero exit or FAILED lines

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
data.title: UPDATE test: assert mode-detect.sh returns dso.workflow value directly
